prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Learn how to summon, minimize, or chat with your pet anytime directly from your desktop.", "Right-click pet for instant action menu", "Use system tray icon to hide or unhide pet", "Got It"]
1: ["If photo processing encounters issues, instant starter styles will be offered automatically.", "Automatic Fallback Protection Enabled"]
2: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Companion", "Warming up desktop rendering engine and preparing pet companion assets...", "Loading desktop graphics pipeline..."]
3: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "Try clicking on your pet right now or right-click to open its desktop action menu.", "Try Desktop Interaction"]
4: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Look for your pet on your screen. You can also right-click the pet icon in your system tray anytime.", "Active in System Tray"]
5: ["Mastering Your Pet Controls", "Quickly summon, talk, or manage your companion using keyboard shortcuts and tray controls.", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide your desktop pet anytime.", "Start Playing"]
6: ["Signing in with your registered account automatically restores your saved pets and progress.", "Existing user? Sign in to restore your saved pets."]
7: ["Preset adoption takes under 1 minute. Custom pet creation takes 2-3 minutes.", "Fastest Option: Preset Pet"]
8: ["Generating official adoption records and initializing pet companion attributes...", "Finalizing pet personality matrix..."]
9: ["Verifying desktop display overlay permissions and system tray notification hooks...", "Desktop System Check OK"]
